title: Ivy Melinda - A flower in the garden: Cultivating a community for Caves of Qud
speaker: Ivy Melinda
talk_title: A flower in the garden: Cultivating a community for Caves of Qud
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

Ivy is a 35 year old, first time community manager for Caves of Qud. She likes weird shit and has a spider plant sitting on my windowsill that whispers dark influence into her ear when she sleeps.

In this talk she shares her own journey into community management and the positivity, potential, love, and benefits of a strongly engaged community. With special guest Eva Problems!

Find her on Twitter: https://twitter.com/a_plantgirl
Check out the Caves of Qud Discord server: https://discord.gg/cavesofqud
